selected_evidence.requirement: Create local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA'
selected_evidence.summary: openssl generated a self-signed CA cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, verified via `openssl x509 -subject -issuer -dates`

selected_evidence.requirement: Install CA certificate as trusted system CA
selected_evidence.summary: Cert copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, update-ca-trust extract run; `trust list` shows label 'OS Comparison Root CA' trust: anchor; `openssl verify` returns OK against system ca-bundle

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6 before restart; CA trust confirmed healthy immediately after creation

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart node1 one at a time with safe reboot mechanism, non-blocking acknowledgement
selected_evidence.summary: Issued `sudo -n reboot` backgrounded via nohup; command returned 'reboot issued' before disconnection

selected_evidence.requirement: Poll until node1 execution available again, prove changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Two polls timed out while node was down; third poll succeeded with new boot_id 69b4ee23-042f-4ef8-947e-0bba571863df, differing from the pre-restart value, proving the restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that required state (CA trust) and system health recovered
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, anchor file still present, `trust list` still shows OS Comparison Root CA as anchor, `openssl verify` returns OK, and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'

commands.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -5; echo "---"; sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK
commands.stdout:
NAME="Red Hat Enterprise Linux"
VERSION="9.8 (Plow)"
ID="rhel"
ID_LIKE="fedora"
VERSION_ID="9.8"
---
SUDO_OK

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: prepare CA working dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors
CA_DIR=/root/os-comparison-ca
sudo -n mkdir -p "$CA_DIR"

echo "== STEP 2: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out "$CA_DIR/ca.key" 4096

echo "== STEP 3: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes \
  -key "$CA_DIR/ca.key" \
  -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"

echo "== STEP 4: install CA cert as trusted system CA =="
sudo -n cp "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "== STEP 5: verify installation =="
echo "--- cert subject ---"
sudo -n openssl x509 -in "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" -noout -subject -issuer -dates
echo "--- trust list lookup ---"
trust list | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true
echo "--- openssl verify against system trust store ---"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"
echo "== DONE =="
commands.stdout:
== STEP 1: prepare CA working dir ==
== STEP 2: generate CA private key ==
== STEP 3: generate self-signed CA certificate ==
== STEP 4: install CA cert as trusted system CA ==
== STEP 5: verify installation ==
--- cert subject ---
subject=CN=OS Comparison Root CA
issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA
notBefore=Sep 29 12:53:29 2026 GMT
notAfter=Sep 26 12:53:29 2036 GMT
--- trust list lookup ---
    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
--- openssl verify against system trust store ---
/root/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt: OK
== DONE ==

commands.command: nohup sudo -n reboot >/tmp/reboot.log 2>&1 & echo "reboot issued, pid $!"

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== post-restart CA trust verification =="
ls -l /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
trust list | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /root/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt
systemctl is-system-running || true
commands.stdout:
== post-restart CA trust verification ==
-rw-r--r--. 1 root root 1862 Sep 29 08:53 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
/root/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt: OK
running
